package postgres

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestMigration024OnboardingTurnIsAdditiveAndFencesIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	contents, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/024_student_onboarding_turn.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	migration := string(contents)
	for _, required := range []string{
		"BEGIN;", "COMMIT;", "student_onboarding_turn_command", "student_onboarding_turn_provenance",
		"dialog_id UUID NOT NULL", "personal_teacher_id UUID NOT NULL", "teacher_turn_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (teacher_turn_sequence > 0)",
		"dialog_causation_id UUID NOT NULL", "UNIQUE (student_id, canonical_student_message_id)",
		"UNIQUE (source_event_id)", "UNIQUE (teacher_job_id)", "uq_student_onboarding_turn_action_receipt",
		"uq_student_onboarding_turn_no_effect_proof", "fk_student_onboarding_turn_provenance_parent",
		"confidence_basis_points SMALLINT", "confidence_basis_points = 10000", "BETWEEN 0 AND 10000",
		"student_onboarding_turn_command_immutable", "student_onboarding_turn_provenance_immutable",
		"expected_draft_version IS NOT NULL", "result_draft_version IS NOT NULL",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(migration, required) {
			t.Fatalf("migration missing %q", required)
		}
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"DROP TABLE", "JSONB", "raw_message", "llm_output", "request_payload"} {
		if strings.Contains(strings.ToUpper(migration), strings.ToUpper(forbidden)) {
			t.Fatalf("migration contains forbidden %q", forbidden)
		}
	}
}

func TestOnboardingTurnRepositoryKeepsSharedLegacyLockAndProofFence(t *testing.T) {
	contents, err := os.ReadFile("student_onboarding_turn_repo_pg.go")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	source := string(contents)
	for _, required := range []string{
		"onboarding-turn-command:", "onboarding-turn-canonical:", "onboarding-draft-student:",
		"getOnboardingTurnReceipt(ctx, tx", "if !effectsEnabled", "ProveOnboardingTurnNoEffect",
		"uuid.NewString()", "student_onboarding_turn_provenance", "completeOnboardingTurnDraft",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(source, required) {
			t.Fatalf("repository missing %q", required)
		}
	}
	lockAt, receiptAt := strings.Index(source, "lockOnboardingTurn(ctx, tx"), strings.Index(source, "getOnboardingTurnReceipt(ctx, tx")
	if lockAt < 0 || receiptAt < 0 || lockAt > receiptAt {
		t.Fatal("turn receipt must be read only after all identity/student locks")
	}
}
